description: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between the number of shots and a value denoted as gamma (γB). The horizontal axis represents “Number of Shots,” with categories labeled 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4, appearing in ascending numerical order; this axis is categorical. The vertical axis is labeled “γB” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.6, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. Five bars are displayed, each with a pink and blue striped pattern. The bar corresponding to 0 shots has an approximate height of 0.63. The bar corresponding to 1 shot has an approximate height of 0.58. The bar corresponding to 2 shots has an approximate height of 0.55. The bar corresponding to 3 shots has an approximate height of 0.53. The bar corresponding to 4 shots has an approximate height of 0.45. The bars are arranged in ascending order based on the “Number of Shots” category. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
